moment: A Singapore hawker centre at lunch rush
title: It's Not Easy Being Mee
story: Kermit’s traded the spotlight for the lunch rush. It’s not easy being green, but at least the noodles match his apron.
world: A Singapore hawker centre at lunchtime: sizzling stalls, crowded tables, clattering bowls, and one suspiciously green noodle cook.

characters.name: Kermit the Frog
quips: This lunch rush needs a stage manager.
No flies in the soup. I checked.
Miss Piggy would demand table service.
characters.line: Hi-ho! One bowl of mee, with extra enthusiasm!

characters.name: Phua Chu Kang
quips: Best lunch in Singapore, JB, some say Batam!
Don't play play with my order.
These boots can tahan any queue.
characters.line: Not me lah! See the yellow boots?

hint.text: Look behind the MEE counter, beside the stacks of white bowls.
